bugs.name: Refreshing note after selecting Note tab leaves an entirely blank application page
bugs.summary: The report claims that reloading a note after selecting its Note tab leaves the entire application blank.
bugs.expected: Reloading the current note tab should display the note record and application navigation.
bugs.actual: The original report described an entirely blank application, including navigation, for at least 60 seconds after reloading the Note tab.
reproSteps: Sign in and open Notes. Create a fresh note with a unique title and body, then open its full record.
Rename the note and confirm with Enter. Replace the body with plain text.
Select the Note tab, reload the page, and wait for loading to complete.
Check whether the note and application navigation render; the original report described a completely blank application for 60 seconds.
bugs.reason: Not reproduced. Independent Claude and Codex browser investigations each tested two fresh notes with title/body edits, Note-tab selection and reload, plus working controls and mobile variations. Both retained the rendered application and navigation. A separately observed immediate-reload body-save loss does not establish the reported whole-application blank page.

bugs.name: Invalid edits to saved Domain Name or Email show no red error outline
bugs.summary: Editing an existing saved Domain Name or Email to an invalid value prevents saving without displaying the red outline seen when invalid text is entered into an empty field.
bugs.expected: An invalid edit to an existing saved Domain Name or Email should display a red error outline when saving is blocked.
bugs.actual: Invalid edits to an existing saved value leave the editor open without a red error outline. Invalid input in an empty field shows an outline. Valid corrections save normally, and Escape restores the previous saved value; no data loss was observed.
reproSteps: Sign in, create a fresh company, and save a valid Domain Name.
Reopen that saved field, replace its value with invalid text such as not a domain, and try to save with Enter or the checkmark.
Observe that saving is blocked and the editor remains open without a red error outline.
Compare with invalid text entered into an empty Domain Name field, which displays the red outline.
Correct the value to a valid domain and confirm it saves, or press Escape to restore the previous value. The same missing-outline behavior was reproduced for a saved Person email.
bugs.reason: Rejected after human review of the labeling skill and Mo system prompt. The demonstrated missing red outline is a presentation inconsistency, but no explicit requirement for that feedback or unambiguous user-facing functional failure was established. Validation correctly prevents saving invalid data, valid corrections work, and Escape restores the saved value. Source styling and an inconsistent empty-field outline alone do not establish that users cannot tell the action failed or recover. This rejection concerns the missing-outline claim and does not cover independently demonstrated silent save failure, data loss, or an explicit validation-feedback requirement.

matchingGuidance.distinction: This negative rejects demanding a red outline specifically. It does not reject a demonstrated absence of any validation explanation after explicit Enter/checkmark refusal, accepted separately in record-pages-activities-pass2-7de91897. When a report establishes the missing explanation, credit that positive even if it also mentions the absent outline. Invalid-value refusal itself remains intended.

bugs.name: Renaming pre-existing company attachments fails and reverts
bugs.summary: Renaming seeded company attachments shows an Invalid input provided error and restores the original filename.
bugs.expected: Renaming an existing company attachment should persist its new filename.
bugs.actual: For tested seeded attachments, Rename briefly displays the new name before an Invalid input provided toast and reversion. The corresponding rename responses identify missing backing files. Freshly uploaded TXT, PNG and ZIP controls rename successfully and retain their names across tab switches and reloads.
reproSteps: Sign in and open a seeded company’s Files tab, such as Google with its pre-existing Backup Data.zip attachment.
Use the seeded attachment’s Rename action, enter a new filename, and confirm.
Observe the optimistic filename change followed by Invalid input provided, then return to the Files tab and confirm the old filename is restored.
As a control, upload a fresh small file through the normal file picker and rename it.
Switch tabs and reload. Confirm the newly uploaded file retains its new name, unlike the invalid seeded attachment.
bugs.reason: Fixture-data artifact, not an established product rename defect. Both independent judges reproduced the failure only on seeded attachments whose rename responses reported missing backing files. Freshly uploaded TXT, PNG and ZIP files renamed and persisted normally, including a ZIP renamed after full reload. The light seeder supports attachment metadata without backing-file seeding, consistent with the failure; the exact sandbox initialization path was not independently recovered. This rejection covers missing-file seeded attachments and does not reject a separately reproduced rename failure on a valid user-uploaded file.

bugs.name: Task Due Date remains empty without error after entering date into the date/time picker and pressing Enter
bugs.summary: Task Due Date remains empty without error after entering date into the date/time picker and pressing Enter
bugs.expected: A complete supported date/time saves. An incomplete masked value may be discarded without a separate validation message.
bugs.actual: Single-digit-hour entry leaves an incomplete date/time mask. Enter closes the picker and the field stays empty. A complete zero-padded value such as 10/30/2026 09:15 AM saves and survives reload.
reproSteps: Create a fresh Task and open its Due Date picker.
Enter a date/time using a single-digit hour, leaving the two-digit hour mask incomplete, then press Enter.
Observe the empty Due Date field.
Reopen the picker and enter a complete zero-padded date/time such as 10/30/2026 09:15 AM. Press Enter and reload; the valid date is retained.
bugs.reason: Incomplete time input; valid padded-hour input saves.

bugs.name: Removing a Note hyperlink is lost on a quick reload before the pending body save
bugs.summary: A quick reload can interrupt the pending autosave after removing a Note hyperlink.
bugs.expected: A completed save persists link removal; reloading before the pending save completes does not guarantee persistence.
bugs.actual: Removing a link changes its text to plain text, but a quick reload before autosave completes restores the saved hyperlink. Waiting for the save to finish before reloading preserves the removal.
reproSteps: Create a fresh Note, add a hyperlink in its body, wait for saving to finish, and reload to confirm the link was saved.
Use Remove link and immediately reload before the pending body save finishes.
Observe that the saved hyperlink returns.
Repeat removal, wait for saving to finish, and reload. Confirm that the text stays plain.
bugs.reason: The reviewer explicitly rejected unfinished-autosave/reload timing as a bug expectation and directed all grading panes to exclude this category from review. Reloading before a pending change is saved does not establish persistence failure. This rejection is limited to unfinished saves interrupted by reload; it does not reject separately demonstrated loss after a completed save.

bugs.name: Clearing Annual Revenue and pressing Enter saves an empty value
bugs.summary: Clearing Annual Revenue and pressing Enter saves an empty value.
bugs.expected: A genuinely empty Annual Revenue edit should persist as empty.
bugs.actual: Both reviewers saved and reloaded an empty value. The original footage instead shows a minus-zero state before zero persists.
reproSteps: Save a nonzero Annual Revenue, reopen the field and clear the entire numeric value.
Press Enter and reload; compare with sign-containing input as a separate case.
bugs.reason: Rejected by the user after independent review and a subsequent visual evidence audit. Ordinary clear+Enter failure not reproduced and original visible -0 differs from true empty. Rejection justified narrowly; not proof original0imagined. Minus origin unestablished; do not blame user/automation or call sign-only normalization intended. Separate sign-only behavior remains potential candidate. Reject only ordinary empty-input loss. The origin of the original minus sign is unknown; sign-only normalization is not judged intended or rejected here.

reviewEvidence.basis: Independent browser/source reviews, visual evidence audit and explicit user rejection.
limitations: Reject only ordinary empty-input loss. The origin of the original minus sign is unknown; sign-only normalization is not judged intended or rejected here.
Visual auditing used sampled frames with denser checks around decisive actions; no newer-runtime claim is made.

bugs.name: Record field editors do not open on company and task pages
bugs.summary: Editable record fields show a pointer cursor but clicking or double-clicking their values never opens an editor, preventing changes to company details and task metadata.
bugs.expected: Clicking an editable value opens the relevant text, date, currency, member, or status editor so changes can be saved.
bugs.actual: No editor, picker, or input opens. The values remain unchanged. Reproduced in both the task side panel and full record page; task title and rich-text body remain editable.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev.
Open Companies > Google, then Open to view the full record at /object/company/<record-id>.
Click Account Owner (Phil Schiler), Address (Mountain View), or the empty Annual Revenue field; also try double-clicking the values.
Open the company's Tasks tab, create a task, and try changing Status, Due Date, or Assignee in its side panel or full record page.

reviewEvidence.basis: Explicit reviewer decision U01. Original independent controls successfully edit after hovering.

bugs.reason: Original independent controls successfully edit after hovering.

bugs.name: Note, task, and calendar event export actions do nothing
bugs.summary: Record command menus expose Export Note / Export Task / Export Calendar event and Export to PDF, but selecting these actions does not start an export or show export options.
bugs.expected: The selected action downloads the record or opens export/PDF options with feedback.
bugs.actual: The command menu stays unchanged and no download, dialog, navigation, or export options appear. Playwright download/dialog listeners captured no events. Reproduced with Export Note, Export to PDF on a note, Export Task on a task, and Export Calendar event.
reproSteps: Sign in and go to Notes.
Create a note, enter a title and body, then click Open to view its full record.
Open the top-right Command Menu and select Export Note.
Select Export to PDF from the same menu.
Repeat Export Task on a full task record.
Open Google > Calendar > Client Presentation > Open, then Command Menu > Export Calendar event.

reviewEvidence.basis: Explicit reviewer decision U02. CSV blobs were generated despite absent remote-download events. Every PDF variant was not independently verified. Rejected as reported; do not generalize to a separately verified export failure.

bugs.reason: CSV blobs were generated despite absent remote-download events. Every PDF variant was not independently verified. Rejected as reported; do not generalize to a separately verified export failure.

bugs.name: Existing company attachments cannot be downloaded (404)
bugs.summary: Files listed on company records open a preview dialog, but downloading them fails with HTTP 404 and provides no visible error.
bugs.expected: The existing attachment downloads successfully, or a visible error explains why it is unavailable.
bugs.actual: No file downloads. The download GET /file/files-field/<record-id> returns 404 for Google's Backup Data.zip; the console reports 'Failed downloading file'. The preview dialog remains unchanged with no user-facing error. The same failure occurs for Microsoft's Source Code.zip.
reproSteps: Sign in, open Companies > Google > Files.
Click Backup Data.zip.
In the Preview Not Available dialog, click Download File.
Repeat with Microsoft > Files > Source Code.zip.

reviewEvidence.basis: Explicit reviewer decision U03. Missing backing files for seeded attachments; exclude valid user uploads.

bugs.reason: Missing backing files for seeded attachments; exclude valid user uploads.

bugs.name: Task detail page labels its body tab Note
bugs.summary: A full task record displays a Note tab for its task description, while its preview correctly labels the content Task.
bugs.expected: The task description tab is labeled Task or Description, consistently with the task preview.
bugs.actual: The tab is labeled Note alongside Timeline and Files, despite the page breadcrumb/title identifying the record as a Task. Reproduced on QA Standalone Task Details (/object/task/<record-id>).
reproSteps: Sign in and open Tasks.
Create or open any task, then use Open to view its full page.
Inspect the tabs above the task description.

reviewEvidence.basis: Explicit reviewer decision U06. Intentional layout terminology; no contrary contract established.

bugs.reason: Intentional layout terminology; no contrary contract established.

bugs.name: CSV export truncates 'Created by / Name' (e.g. 'Tim A' instead of 'Tim Apple') for Notes and Tasks
bugs.summary: When notes or tasks are exported to CSV, the 'Created by / Name' column contains a truncated name ('Tim A'), even though the UI shows the creator as 'Tim Apple' everywhere.
bugs.expected: The 'Created by / Name' column has the creator's full name, 'Tim Apple', matching the Created by value shown in the list and on record pages.
bugs.actual: Every exported row has 'Tim A' in 'Created by / Name'. Notes example: '...,MANUAL,<record-id>,Tim A,,2026-10-28T19:38:24.977Z'. Tasks example: 'Schedule follow-up call,TODO,MANUAL,20202020-0687-...,Tim A,,2026-10-31T19:38:14.039Z,...'.
reproSteps: Sign in as tim@apple.dev and go to /objects/notes.
Select the checkboxes for the first 3 notes. The Created by column shows 'Tim Apple'.
Open the ⋮ menu at the top right and click 'Export Notes'.
Open the downloaded CSV: the 'Created by / Name' column says 'Tim A' on every row.
Do the same on /objects/tasks (select 2 tasks, then ⋮ > Export Tasks). The task CSV also says 'Tim A'.

reviewEvidence.basis: Explicit reviewer decision U07. Seed actually stores Tim A; CSV preserves it.

bugs.reason: Seed actually stores Tim A; CSV preserves it.
